title: Cognition in breast cancer survivors: A pilot study of interval and continuous exercise
journal: Journal of Science and Medicine in Sport
notes: Three-arm pilot RCT (HIIT n=6, MOD n=5, CON n=6). Female breast cancer survivors <=24mo post-diagnosis aged 50-75. 12-week cycle ergometer intervention. Primary: CogState battery (not in INSTRUMENT_REGISTRY). Secondary: TCD cerebrovascular and VO2peak. Only VO2peak reached significance (p=0.02). HIIT showed moderate-to-large effects on cognition and cerebrovascular function. High adherence (78-79%) with no adverse events. All cognitive effects non-significant due to small sample. HIIT vs CON extracted as primary comparison; MOD vs CON noted but not separately entered (shared control group).
